hero.title: 1 Week to change your life
hero.description: Start with how you use your body every day. A week of guided practice to understand how you move, explore new possibilities, and learn how to continue at home.
hero.promise: Not to become someone else. To have more agency in the things you want to do.
practice.title: More than following movements. Learn to notice and adjust.
practice.observeBody: Start with how you move now and what you want to do.
practice.tryBody: Practise with guidance, try adjustments, and notice what changes each time.
practice.homeBody: Understand what you have practised so you can keep exploring in everyday life.
practice.credentials: Verified credentials and real teaching footage will be added once confirmed.
goals.title: What do you want to use your body for?
goals.body: Play with your children. Take a trip. Enjoy your favourite sport. Or simply feel more comfortable and confident moving.
goals.note: You don't need a grand goal. Something that genuinely matters to you is enough to begin.

values.communityBody: Learn together, support each other, and build a future greater than any of us can create alone.
values.resultsBody: Meet each person where they are. Adapt the guidance so progress matters to the individual.
values.growthBody: Everything is training. NLF is a vehicle for our awakening in every way.
values.humilityBody: A genuine environment of learning does not come from saying that we already know everything.
faq.title: Questions you may be wondering about.
faq.startQuestion: Where should I start if I am new to NLF?
faq.startAnswer: Tell the team what you want to do and your previous experience. They can explain each programme's entry requirements. Structured requires completion of Fundamental.
faq.limitationsQuestion: What if I have movement limitations?
faq.limitationsAnswer: Speak privately with the team before attending. If you are receiving treatment or have movement restrictions, consult your treating professional. Workshops do not replace medical assessment or treatment.
faq.detailsAnswer: Teaching language, Vietnamese support, what to bring, and change or cancellation terms will be confirmed for each session before registration opens.
faq.continueQuestion: How can I continue after the workshop?
faq.continueAnswer: The community and 90-day online programme offer ongoing practice: five days a week, morning and evening slots, one hour per session. Dates and eligibility are to be confirmed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: NLF Vietnam uses your name, phone number, programme selection, language and optional note to handle your enquiry and contact you about the programme. Details are stored in a Neon database in Singapore for access by authorised team members. We record the time and version of your consent; do not submit medical records here. To request correction or deletion, contact NLF through the Zalo advice group and ask for a private conversation. Details are not automatically published or sent to marketing services. Anti-spam identifiers are hashed; raw IP addresses are not stored.
practice.note: You don't need all the answers before you arrive. You are here to learn.

goals.dailyBody: Bending, sitting, standing, walking — things you want to do with less hesitation.
goals.enjoyBody: Walk, play a sport, explore somewhere new.
goals.understandBody: Notice what you are doing instead of simply trying harder.

trainer.title: Guidance from people who learn alongside you.
trainer.body: Travis and the NLF Vietnam team guide the practice. Ask about the teaching approach, language support, and workshop requirements before deciding to attend.
workshops.note: An enquiry does not reserve a place or take payment. Confirm the schedule, content, inclusions, and participation requirements with the team before deciding.
workshops.other: Can't make a full week? Explore other options
faq.readyQuestion: Do I need to be fit or flexible already?
faq.readyAnswer: Don't rule yourself out because you think you aren't good enough. Each workshop has its own requirements; discuss your current abilities before deciding.
faq.scheduleQuestion: What if I cannot attend the full schedule?
faq.scheduleAnswer: Ask before paying so you understand attendance requirements and available options. Make-up sessions should not be assumed.
faq.paymentQuestion: How do payment and reservations work?
faq.paymentAnswer: This form records an enquiry only; it does not take payment or reserve a place. Ask the team to confirm the fee, deposit, and payment terms before transferring money.
faq.cancelQuestion: What if I need to cancel or change dates?
faq.cancelAnswer: Request the workshop's cancellation, rescheduling, and refund policy before paying. Terms are not yet published here; do not assume all payments are refundable.
